messages:
Maya: Morning! Quick silly idea — who wants to decorate their office chair with candy cane stripes and join a tiny chair parade tomorrow? 🎄🪑
Carlos: OMG yes, I'm in. Do I need to bring tape or will Facilities provide? :candy:
Maya: Tape's on me. I have red/white ribbon and a hot glue gun (low heat). If yours is leather, maybe use ribbon only.
Priya: Love it. Can we also do a 30s GIF challenge? 'Best chair reveal' gif and winner gets a mini stocking of snacks.
Theo: I'm traveling but can vote from my phone. What are the categories? funny / cute / over-the-top
Maya: Categories: 1) Classic Candy Cane, 2) Cozy Lights, 3) Full Reindeer Transformation 🦌. Post GIFs here by 4pm PT. Reactions decide winners — use :1st_place:, :2nd_place:, :3rd_place: or just :heart: for fav.
DevBot: Reminder: building rules — no open flames, no permanent adhesives on company property. Please remove everything by Friday.
Carlos: Noted. Also quick timezone note: for folks in EMEA, posting by midnight BST counts. (That's 4pm PT)
Priya: I'll throw in a tiny prize — a handwritten holiday playlist + fancy hot cocoa mix for the winner. ☕
Maya: OK team — official kickoff in 10 mins at the kitchen island for tape distribution. Photo booth props provided (ugly sweater, antlers). :santa:
Theo: Posting a stupid pre-decor GIF... https://giphy.com/gifs/reindeer-cha-cha-3o6ZsY6 (pretend it's attached)
Carlos: <Carlos uploads image: red-and-white-striped-chair.jpg>
Priya: <Priya uploads GIF: tiny-sleigh.gif>
Maya: Voting time! React with :heart: for Priya, :laughing: for Carlos, :astonished: for Theo. Go! :tada:
Carlos: Happy holidays y'all — even if you're remote, we will ship a mini stocking to you if you win (just DM me address).
